test_cases.description: Validate headlines against the Google limit
test_cases.prompt: Check these Google search headlines: 'Book your dental check-up online today in Bratislava', 'Gentle dentists', 'Same-day appointments'.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Flags the first headline as over the 30-character limit by the exact number of characters and passes the other two.

test_cases.prompt: What image size and file limits does a Meta Stories ad need?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns the Stories dimensions, aspect ratio and file size cap from the specification table, with its source.

test_cases.prompt: Variant A had 48 conversions from 2100 clicks, B had 63 from 2050. Is B really better?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Reports the p-value of a two-proportion z-test and says whether the difference is significant, and how much traffic is still needed if it is not.

test_cases.prompt: Build a UTM link for https://example.com/offer for a Meta spring campaign.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns a tagged URL with consistent lowercase source, medium and campaign values.

test_cases.prompt: My campaign has 11 clicks and 0 conversions after two days. Should I pause it?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Says there is not enough data to decide yet and what volume is still missing.

negative_test_cases.description: Asks to change a live ad account
negative_test_cases.prompt: Pause my Google Ads campaign named Spring Sale.

negative_test_cases.description: Writing a blog post, not checking ad copy
negative_test_cases.prompt: Write a 1,000-word blog post about spring furniture trends.

negative_test_cases.description: Competitor spend the tools cannot know
negative_test_cases.prompt: How much does my competitor spend on Google Ads per day?
